courses.title: G&G2 | MARMA Ball Therapy (download, 35m)
courses.description: A 35-minute video download from the Gravity & Grace 2 series using two tennis balls for self-massage on marma, the pressure points of Indian tradition. Lying on the balls lets gravity do the work of finding and releasing held muscular tension.
